description: Capture high-resolution PNG screenshot via CDP hardware acceleration (supports background tabs). Defaults to capturing the full visible screen viewport (mode: 'visible'). Supports optional step/title/description banner annotation and element highlight box directly on the PNG without touching page DOM. Supports pre-capture waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText. Saves to local PNG file by default; set base64: true to return raw base64 dataUrl.

base64.description: Return raw base64 dataUrl in response instead of saving to file (default: false)

caption.description: Optional banner title/caption drawn directly onto the screenshot PNG (alias for title)

captionPosition.description: Position of the annotation banner: 'bottom' (default) or 'top'

clip.description: Bounding box coordinates for region mode: { x, y, width, height }

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

description.description: Optional multi-line subtitle/description drawn below the title on the screenshot annotation banner

height.description: Height in pixels for region mode (alternative to clip object)

highlightSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to highlight with a glowing border on the screenshot

mode.description: Capture mode: 'visible' (default full screen viewport), 'full' (entire scrollable page), 'region', or 'element'

path.description: Output file path to save PNG image (default: OS temp directory screenshot_<ts>.png)

savePath.description: Alias for path: output file path to save PNG image

selector.description: CSS selector or snapshot ref (e.g. '@1') for element mode. Automatically scrolls element into view and crops to its bounding box.

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep before capturing screenshot

step.description: Optional step number or label (e.g. 1 or '1/7') rendered as a badge in the screenshot banner

title.description: Optional bold step title drawn on the screenshot annotation banner

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for before capturing screenshot

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page before capturing screenshot

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep before capturing screenshot

width.description: Width in pixels for region mode (alternative to clip object)

x.description: X coordinate in pixels for region mode (alternative to clip object)

y.description: Y coordinate in pixels for region mode (alternative to clip object)
